title: ProposalApproveRequest
description: The input of proposal.approve, as §26.1's table gives it: the canonical URI of the waiting proposal, and the fingerprint of the request the approver saw, which DSoR compares with the stored one (DSOR-APR-09; step 29's README, decision D1). The pattern is the specification's resourceUri; the /proposal/ part beside it is this tutorial's.

payload_hash.description: The fingerprint of the stored request, sha256: and the hex digest of its RFC 8785 canonical JSON (DSOR-APR-02b).
